## Speed-to-Lead SLA Monitor + Weekly Report
READ-ONLY on HubSpot. Every 5 minutes it finds new leads / form submissions, looks up their first outbound touch (call, email, meeting booked, sequence enrollment), and alerts Slack on at-risk / breached SLAs.
Mondays 08:00 it posts a rep-level response-time report.

**Before activating:** attach your HubSpot App Token credential, set env vars (see docs/CONFIGURATION.md), run with `SANDBOX_MODE=true` first.
Use the "Manual Test" trigger to dry-run without waiting.

Use at your own risk - see DISCLAIMER.md.

nodes.name: Load Config
nodes.notes: Reads env vars, validates them, builds the HubSpot search body.

nodes.name: Search New Leads
nodes.notes: Returns up to 100 contacts created (or form-resubmitted) inside the lookback window.

nodes.name: Get Associations
nodes.notes: Runs once each for calls, emails, meetings.

nodes.name: Read Engagement Details
nodes.notes: Batch-reads timestamps and direction for the associated calls / emails / meetings.

nodes.name: Evaluate SLA
nodes.notes: Business-hours SLA math, de-duplication, weekly summary.

nodes.name: Sandbox: Preview Only
nodes.notes: SANDBOX_MODE is on: the Slack payload is shown here but NOT posted. Paste payload.blocks into Slack Block Kit Builder to preview.

nodes.name: Post to Slack
nodes.notes: Slack incoming webhook URL comes from the SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL environment variable.
